artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Samuel H. Kress Collection) and Edward E. MacCrone Fund
artworks.description: This is an image of a crucifixion scene. The central figure is on a cross flanked by two others. A crowd with details of helmets and spears is in the background. The drawing uses fine linework and shading in a monochrome palette, capturing the somber atmosphere. There are hints of architectural forms and a soft horizon line, suggesting a distant cityscape.

artworks.title: A Fortified Village along a River
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of graphite; Zanetti mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river, a group of figures by the water's edge, and architectural elements in the distance. The river divides the scene, with buildings and a tall tower visible on the horizon. The artwork features detailed line work and cross-hatching, using a subdued color palette dominated by earthy tones.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady Sewing
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a large, yellow-striped upholstered chair, with her body mostly visible from head to foot. She is positioned sideways in the chair, her head turned towards the viewer with a gentle smile. The woman has dark, loose hair adorned with a large, white hat featuring a wide, slightly drooping brim. Her facial features are delicate and softly defined, complementing her demure expression. She is dressed in a modest ensemble consisting of a light shawl draped over her shoulders and a brown skirt adorned with a pattern of white and red spots. Her hands hold a piece of fabric or cloth in her lap. The background of the image is plain and dark, which contrasts with the lighter tones of the chair and her clothing, emphasizing her presence in the scene.

artworks.title: Hans Felbbier
artworks.description: The image shows a man with short hair and a neat beard, dressed in elaborate historical attire. He is portrayed in a formal pose within an oval frame with decorative script. The background is plain with subtle texture, highlighting the man's appearance.

artworks.title: Jane Morris
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink with brown wash on laid paper; laid down on paperboard
artworks.description: The upper half of a person's body is shown in the image. The individual is in a relaxed pose on a sofa, with one arm resting on the furniture and the other draped across their lap. The person's soft facial features are visible under wavy hair that falls to the shoulders. They are wearing a long, flowing garment. The background features cross-hatched shading for texture. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is created with sketched lines, adding to the overall monochromatic and sketch-like style of the image.

artworks.title: Bacchus
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in gold and two shades of brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure holding a cup in their right hand and a bunch of grapes in their left hand, standing upright with their body turned slightly to the left. The figure has curly hair adorned with a leafy crown and is unclothed, wearing only a draped cloak around their neck and back. The background features a circular motif with a stylized scorpion in the upper left corner, against a plain backdrop. The ground is rocky with scattered plants.

artworks.title: Hesbeen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.8 x 20.4 cm (5 1/16 x 8 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with an elevated perspective. The horizon is positioned about one-third from the top, featuring a row of trees and buildings blending into the landscape. A church with a tall spire is a focal point. The artwork uses fine, detailed lines to depict textures in the trees, buildings, and sky, with cross-hatching for shading. The color scheme is monochromatic with black ink on a pale background. Two figures walk along a path towards a cluster of buildings and trees. The sky has wispy clouds, contributing to the serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Allegory on the Death of the Dauphin
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red-brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene under draped curtains with divine attributes. The drawing features a group of classical figures clustered together, enveloped in rich drapery. At the top, sunlight radiates from a crescent and star emblem. Below this light, figures are depicted with expressions of reflection or discovery. There is a use of chiaroscuro for depth. Some figures have symbols like books. Earthy tones and intricate lines suggest classical motifs and composition.

artworks.title: An der Haidnaab
artworks.description: The image shows a scenic landscape with a sweeping view, emphasizing the sky and rocky cliffs with tree details and a monochromatic sepia color palette. Two figures and grazing cattle can be seen on the right side.

artworks.title: Waldstrom bey Teissnach
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a dense forest, rocky outcrops, and a waterfall. The detailed engraving shows intricate cross-hatching and fine lines to depict textures. The color palette is sepia, creating a classic feel. A human figure is present on a large rock observing the scenery.

artworks.title: Altarpiece of the Madonna and Child with Saints, in Its Architectural Setting
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a seated figure at the center, potentially on a throne, with two other standing figures close by. The central figure is holding a smaller figure on their lap. The sketch does not show detailed facial features or hair, but instead the figures from head to toe. The figures are wearing robes or draped garments, with flowing lines in the sketch to represent this. No jewelry or objects other than the smaller figure are included in the sketch. Around the scene is an architectural structure with columns and an arch, decorated with ornamental elements above, suggesting a religious or ceremonial setting. The background consists of the architectural features, without any additional scenery depicted.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative title page with cherubs and lavish drapery. The image features ornate detailing with two cherubs, one on each side, which are wrapped in flowing drapery that frames a text panel in the center. The text panel is intricately integrated into the overall design, adorned with rich scrollwork and floral motifs. The scene is both symmetrical and balanced, with delicate linework enhancing the fluidity and elegance of the composition. The meticulous attention to decorative elements suggests a refinement typical of classical styles, conveying a sense of grandeur and opulence in the artwork's design.

artworks.title: Figure Studies including Woman with a Kettle
artworks.description: The image is a sketch featuring several figures and one detailed portrait. In the foreground, there is a seated woman shown in profile, holding a stick. A second woman is standing bent forward. In the lower right corner, there is a detailed side profile of a man with unruly hair. Additional outlines in the background depict more figures and hints of a rural landscape.

artworks.title: Figure Studies including Two Seated Peasants
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people engaged in different activities in a rural setting. Multiple figures are depicted working in a field, with two figures having a conversation with a basket between them. The drawing is detailed, showing individuals engaged in tasks related to agriculture or harvest. In the foreground, a seated figure holds one end of cloth, while another stands facing them. Other figures in the background are depicted busy with various tasks, including a person with a cart. The composition of lines creates a narrative of daily labor and interaction, capturing the essence of a communal or working environment.

artworks.title: Figures in a Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two main figures depicted in the foreground, with partial body views rendered for each. One figure stands to the left, clothed in a long garment, high collar, long sleeves, and a cape. They wear a wide-brimmed hat and have their head slightly tilted down. The other figure sits on a chair with a straight posture, exhibiting somewhat curly hair, a calm expression, and gazing downwards. Both wear long robes with a cinched waist. Surrounding the seated figure are additional figures sitting on benches and carrying baskets. The background features sparse details of a garden setting with leafy plants. The drawing is characterized by a minimalistic, pen-like style with thin lines and monochrome coloring.

artworks.title: Figure Studies including Reclining Boy
artworks.description: The image shows sketches of various figures and scenes. In the foreground, two figures lie on the ground. One figure is seen from the back, sitting with bent legs and short hair. The other figure is reclining, propped up on their left arm, wearing a loose garment and a head covering. Their face is facing downwards. There are also sketches of a walking stick and a basket nearby. In the background, there are lightly sketched figures, including two people close together and another person in a long dress and hat. A face with expressive eyes and a hat is visible in the lower left corner. The illustration is rough and sketch-like, with no specific background details.

artworks.title: Seated Mother and Child, Two Standing Peasants
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. On the left, a seated woman is holding a baby. Beside her is a basket. To the right, a standing man is seen from the back, holding a basket with herbs or flowers. In the background, a woman is walking while carrying a basket filled with grasses or herbs. The setting implies an outdoor environment, like a field, with sparse vegetation.

artworks.title: Figure Studies including  Standing Boy Holding a Pitcher
artworks.description: An etching with three main figures depicted from varying angles, along with small sketches of people in the background. The left figure is a seated woman, head resting on hand and eyes closed. She wears a cap, long-sleeved dress, and a shawl. The figure in the center is a man with an obscured face wearing a floppy hat, smiling slightly. The figure on the right is a young boy standing with a walking stick, looking to the side with curly hair under his hat. In the background, there are sketches of other people. The setting is against a plain background, focusing on the figures and their interactions.

artworks.title: Seated Shepherd Boys
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals seated on the ground. The first individual, on the left, is facing slightly away and has their legs bent. The second individual, on the right, is seated with one leg stretched out and the other drawn up. Both individuals have medium-length hair and are wearing loose garments with wide-brimmed hats. The person on the right is holding a long staff. There are round objects near them that could be bags or canteens. In the background, there are sketched foliage or bushes. The drawing is monochrome with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Figure Studies including Bearded Face of an Old Man
artworks.description: The image features several figures: an older man's detailed face in the upper left, a group of seated men below him, a young woman with a basket of plants in the center right, and a boy in the bottom right. The background is minimal, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: Seated Woman with Peasant Boy Holding a Basket
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals. One is seated, leaning against a sketched tree trunk with foliage behind them. They have long hair tied back, are wearing a long dress, and appear to be holding an object. The other person stands next to them, looking down with slightly bent posture. They have curly hair, wear loose-fitting clothing with a sash at the waist, and carry a large basket. The background shows light illustrations of natural scenery.

artworks.title: Figure Studies including Seated Mother and Child
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of four figures. The central figure is seated, while three figures stand to the right. The figures are draped in loose fabric, with abstract shapes suggesting grass and foliage in the background. There are no noticeable jewelry or objects, aside from the garments and a small basket near the seated figure. The figures are depicted without detailed facial features, focusing on form and posture.

artworks.title: Reclining Shepherd Boys
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals reclining on the ground. The person on the left is in a semi-reclining position with legs extended. The individual on the right is leaning back on one arm with their body slightly twisted. Both individuals have soft features, curly hair, and wear loose clothing. The background is minimally detailed with hints of grass and foliage. The scene is depicted in a line-drawing style.

artworks.title: The Laying of the Atlantic Cable at Foilhommerum Bay, Ireland
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and brush and gray wash with white gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view from an elevated point, looking at rugged cliffs by the sea. The cliffs dominate the scene, receding into softer hills in the background. The horizon is visible above the cliffs, emphasizing the open sky. The brushstrokes are delicate, defining the texture of the cliffs and sea. The color palette is muted with earthy tones. The sea is depicted as rocky and turbulent with small boats. Structures are seen on the cliffs in the distance.
